items.title: Launching Sora responsibly
items.summary: To address the novel safety challenges posed by a state-of-the-art video model as well as a new social creation platform, we’ve built Sora 2 and the Sora app with safety at the foundation. Our approach is anchored in concrete protections.

items.title: Sora 2 System Card
items.summary: Sora 2 is our new state of the art video and audio generation model. Building on the foundation of Sora, this new model introduces capabilities that have been difficult for prior video models to achieve– such as more accurate physics, sharper realism, synchronized audio, enhanced steerability, and an expanded stylistic range.

items.title: Sora 2 is here
items.summary: This post introduced Sora 2, a video generation model with synchronized dialogue and sound effects. The Sora product is no longer available.
